findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job, get_similar_jobs, get_job_pathways, search_certifications, get_certification, search_trainings, get_training, search_training_centers, get_training_center, resolve_location · Private data: get_certification, get_training, get_training_center · Public sink: get_similar_jobs, get_training_center.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job, get_similar_jobs, get_job_pathways, search_certifications, get_certification, search_trainings, get_training, search_training_centers, get_training_center, resolve_location · Private data: get_certification, get_training, get_training_center · Public sink: get_similar_jobs, get_training_center

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
